column1: # Hand labels for `make voa-classify ARGS="--validate docs/reports/voa-classify-labels.tsv"`.
# 50 passages of ~/sonari-trimmed/voa/trimmed.jsonl, drawn with seed 20261007 (stratified by the type the
# classifier gave; `--sample 50` prints them in shuffled order with no tag). Each was read in full and
# labelled BEFORE the classifier's tag was looked at, by one labeller (the assistant, not the owner).
# Columns: id, type, safety categories (comma list, or -), note.
# Type: what the text IS. Safety: a category is set when it is the main subject or a distinct, sizeable
# part (a section of its own, about a tenth of the text); a passing mention is not.
